name: Tuamumain
text: Tuamumain is a variant form of the Old Irish name Tuadmumu. The dictionary prints the head as a one-line cross-reference. Tuadmumu names North Munster in Old Irish. The fuller record sits under the Tuadmumu node, with Thomond behind it.
